system.description:
A tongue of fire lashes out from the caster’s gaping maw and bathes his enemies in flames. Damaging effect spell: Power = Will +3, VA: 2. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Sword; Range: as Pistol.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 3.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Paces | Element: Fire | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 212
